
// Compiled only into the explicitly unlimited research overlay.
func TestIssue182UnlimitedFilesReachClient(t *testing.T) {
	for _, count := range []int{5, 17} {
		document := planningDocument()
		document.Files = nil
		base := candidatePrepared(t).Document.Files[0]
		for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
			file := base
			name := "fixture/" + strings.Repeat("x", i+1) + ".go"
			file.ID = "file-" + strings.Repeat("x", i+1)
			file.NewPath = &name
			document.Files = append(document.Files, file)
		}
		prepared, err := contextinput.Prepare(context.Background(), document, contextinput.BudgetConfig{Context: "16k", MaxContextTokens: contextinput.Context16K}, Renderer(English), nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		prepared.Budget.ContextTokens = contextinput.Context64K
		client := &candidateClient{err: errors.New("research client reached")}
		_, err = (ThreePhaseGenerator{Client: client}).Generate(context.Background(), prepared, English, SensitiveValues{})
		if client.calls != 1 || err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%d files: calls=%d err=%v", count, client.calls, err)
		}
	}
}
